source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: identity.smtpServerKey is a pref-bound XUL menulist ID. Its CSS selector escapes the dot, and current inline-size:0 with flex1 permits shrinkage when a long SMTP label would force page width. Do not rename the persisted/bound ID merely to match a new lowerCamelCase convention. The geometry is source-backed; long-label,zoom and RTL rendering were not run.
title: Preserve persisted dotted DOM IDs and escape them in CSS
